in_sanskrit.name: Nanak
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Given by God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nanak एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Nanak means 'given by God'. This name holds significant importance in Sikhism, where Guru Nanak Dev Ji is the first of the ten Sikh gurus. He is believed to have founded the Sikh religion and set an example of living a righteous life.

in_marathi.name: Nanak
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Given by God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nanak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nanak means 'given by God'. This name holds significant importance in Sikhism, where Guru Nanak Dev Ji is the first of the ten Sikh gurus. He is believed to have founded the Sikh religion and set an example of living a righteous life.
